notes: 501(c)(3), founded 2018. Direct TNR/rescue help LIMITED to Flatbush/East Flatbush (11203, 11225, 11226, 11210 north of Ave H); ~24hr response, not an emergency line, priority to TNR-certified volunteers; refers others to Mayor's Alliance/Neighborhood Cats.
